dynamic_horizon_radius.name: Dynamic Causal Horizon Radius
dynamic_horizon_radius.description: Continuous causal expansion horizon scale R(t) = c * t in metric coordinate time t.
dynamic_horizon_radius.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 1.4 Sec. II

dynamic_expansion_rate_temporal.name: Dynamic Expansion Rate (Temporal)
dynamic_expansion_rate_temporal.description: Continuous cosmological expansion rate H(t) = 1 / t as a function of metric time.
dynamic_expansion_rate_temporal.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 1.2 Sec. III

dynamic_expansion_rate_geometric.name: Dynamic Expansion Rate (Geometric)
dynamic_expansion_rate_geometric.description: Continuous expansion rate expressed in horizon radius H(R) = c / R.

dynamic_critical_acceleration_temporal.name: Dynamic Critical Acceleration Scale (Temporal)
dynamic_critical_acceleration_temporal.description: Fundamental horizon acceleration scale in metric time: a_c(t) = (c * n) / t.
dynamic_critical_acceleration_temporal.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 1.3 Sec. II; Paper 2.1 Sec. III

dynamic_critical_acceleration_geometric.name: Dynamic Critical Acceleration Scale (Geometric)
dynamic_critical_acceleration_geometric.description: Fundamental horizon acceleration scale in horizon radius: a_c(R) = (c^2 / R) * n.
dynamic_critical_acceleration_geometric.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.5 Sec. II

dynamic_metric_clock_lapse.name: Dynamic Metric Clock Lapse
dynamic_metric_clock_lapse.description: Differential conversion rate between proper time tau and coordinate time t: eta(t) = (t / t_ref)^(n/2).
dynamic_metric_clock_lapse.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 1.2 Sec. II; Paper 1.6 Sec. II

worldline_differential_relation.name: Worldline Proper-Time Metric Relation
worldline_differential_relation.description: Exact relativistic line element differential connecting clock proper time tau to coordinate time t.
worldline_differential_relation.paper_refs: Paper 1.2 Sec. II; Paper 1.3 Sec. II

proper_to_coordinate_derivative_operator.name: Worldline Derivative Transformation Operator
proper_to_coordinate_derivative_operator.description: Formal operator relation preventing derivative skew between proper time and coordinate time.

dynamic_root_gravity_algebraic_constrain.name: Root Gravity Algebraic Constraint
dynamic_root_gravity_algebraic_constrain.description: The fundamental quadratic field constraint g_eff^2 - g_N * g_eff - g_N * a_c = 0.

dynamic_root_gravity.name: Dynamic Non-Linear Root Gravity Solution
dynamic_root_gravity.description: First-principles algebraic solution for effective acceleration at epoch t, derived from the quadratic constraint.
dynamic_root_gravity.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Eq. (14); Paper 2.2 Eq. (2); Paper 2.5 Eq. (3)

dynamic_vacuum_relaxation_timescale.name: Dynamic Vacuum Relaxation Timescale
dynamic_vacuum_relaxation_timescale.description: Screened vacuum healing timescale tau(t, g_N) derived from base timescale, stiffness, and critical acceleration.

dynamic_relaxation_ode_coordinate_time.name: Dynamic Vacuum Relaxation ODE (Coordinate Frame)
dynamic_relaxation_ode_coordinate_time.description: Dissipation equation for dynamic metric lapse in observer laboratory frame coordinate time t.

dynamic_relaxation_ode_proper_time.name: Dynamic Vacuum Relaxation ODE (Proper Worldline Frame)
dynamic_relaxation_ode_proper_time.description: Dissipation equation for dynamic metric lapse derived via worldline transformation operator d/d tau.

derive_epoch_hubble_constant.name: Present Hubble Rate Boundary Evaluation
derive_epoch_hubble_constant.description: Boundary evaluation of continuous H(t) at present cosmological observation epoch t = t_0: H_0 = 1 / t_0.
derive_epoch_hubble_constant.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.3 Sec. II

derive_epoch_horizon_scale.name: Present Causal Horizon Scale
derive_epoch_horizon_scale.description: Boundary evaluation of continuous R(t) at present epoch: R_0 = c * t_0 = c / H_0.

derive_epoch_critical_acceleration.name: Present Critical Acceleration Scale
derive_epoch_critical_acceleration.description: Boundary evaluation of continuous a_c(t) at present epoch: a_0 = c * H_0 * n.
derive_epoch_critical_acceleration.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.5 Sec. II

derive_epoch_relaxation_timescale.name: Present Unscreened Relaxation Timescale
derive_epoch_relaxation_timescale.description: Boundary evaluation of continuous unscreened vacuum memory timescale tau(t_0, 0) at present epoch.

derive_geometric_dilution_exponent.name: Geometric Dilution Exponent Derivation
derive_geometric_dilution_exponent.description: Analytic derivation of n from the dimensional ratio of 3D Euclidean volume to 2D spherical horizon: n = 3 / (4 * pi).
derive_geometric_dilution_exponent.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. I; Paper 2.3 Sec. II

derive_geometric_stiffness_factor.name: Geometric Relaxation Stiffness Factor
derive_geometric_stiffness_factor.description: Analytic derivation of dynamic relaxation stiffness: k = n / sqrt(2) = 3 / (4 * pi * sqrt(2)).

derive_zero_parameter_critical_accelerat.name: Zero-Parameter Boundary Acceleration Scale
derive_zero_parameter_critical_accelerat.description: Derived by substituting n = 3 / (4*pi) into epoch acceleration: a_0 = (3 * c * H_0) / (4 * pi).

derive_zero_parameter_relaxation_timesca.name: Zero-Parameter Base Relaxation Timescale
derive_zero_parameter_relaxation_timesca.description: Derived by substituting n = 3 / (4*pi) into epoch relaxation: tau_0 = (4 * pi * sqrt(2)) / (3 * H_0).

derive_redshift_critical_acceleration_ze.name: Zero-Parameter Redshift Critical Acceleration
derive_redshift_critical_acceleration_ze.description: Derived by substituting n = 3 / (4*pi) into redshift-scaled critical acceleration: a_c(z) = a_0 * (1+z)^(3 / (2*pi)).
derive_redshift_critical_acceleration_ze.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.1 Sec. III

derive_keplerian_asymptotic_series.name: Asymptotic Keplerian Screening Series
derive_keplerian_asymptotic_series.description: Taylor series expansion of root gravity in high-acceleration regime (g_N >> a_0), recovering standard General Relativity.
derive_keplerian_asymptotic_series.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.5 Sec. II

derive_mond_asymptotic_series.name: Asymptotic Deep-Field MOND Limit
derive_mond_asymptotic_series.description: Puiseux series expansion of root gravity in low-acceleration regime (g_N << a_0), yielding deep MOND scaling.
derive_mond_asymptotic_series.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Sec. II; Paper 2.5 Sec. II

derive_tully_fisher_relation.name: Baryonic Tully-Fisher Relation
derive_tully_fisher_relation.description: Zero-parameter analytical proof of the flat rotation curve relation v^4 = G * M * a_0.

derive_comoving_distance.name: Cosmological Comoving Distance
derive_comoving_distance.description: Exact first-principles integral of coordinate distance: D_C(z) = (c / H_0) * ln(1+z).

derive_luminosity_distance_zero_paramete.name: Zero-Parameter Luminosity Distance
derive_luminosity_distance_zero_paramete.description: Derived by substituting n = 3 / (4*pi) into parametric luminosity distance: d_L(z) = (c / H_0) * (1+z)^(1 + 3/(8*pi)) * ln(1+z).

derive_distance_modulus_zero_parameter.name: Zero-Parameter Distance Modulus
derive_distance_modulus_zero_parameter.description: Hubble diagram distance modulus mu(z) evaluated from zero-parameter luminosity distance.

derive_supernova_time_dilation_zero_para.name: Supernova Duration Redshift Stretching
derive_supernova_time_dilation_zero_para.description: Derived by substituting n = 3 / (4*pi) into light-curve duration stretching: Delta t_obs = Delta t_emit * (1+z)^(1 - 3/(8*pi)).
derive_supernova_time_dilation_zero_para.paper_refs: Paper 1.1 Eq. (10); Paper 1.2 Sec. III; Paper 2.3 Sec. III

derive_cluster_decoupling_displacement.name: Cluster Decoupling Displacement Offset
derive_cluster_decoupling_displacement.description: Kinematic lag offset Delta r for colliding cluster mergers under screened vacuum relaxation.

derive_wide_binary_velocity_boost_zero_p.name: Zero-Parameter Wide Binary Velocity Boost
derive_wide_binary_velocity_boost_zero_p.description: Orbital velocity boost ratio gamma = v_rel / v_N derived from root gravity with zero-parameter acceleration scale a_0.
